title: 第23章 飞鸿仙子第24章 咱俩加个联系方式吧
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了

“你们这里收丹药吧！”
陈长生有些不好意思的拢了拢头发，他手里只有一品丹药，也不知道灵药阁收不收。
不过他这一下拢头发的动作倒是迷倒了不少人，旁边一名负责人连忙走了过来抱拳道：“原来仙子是位炼丹师，我们这里收丹药的，请随我到二楼雅间。”
说完那负责人还下意识看了眼陈长生胸前那一道深沟，暗自狠狠吞了口唾沫。
“乖乖，这沟能夹死人！”
察觉到负责人猥琐的目光，陈长生不由浑身打了个冷颤，心里再次把红云老祖的祖宗十八代问候了几遍。
那人一边在前面带路一边问道：“敢问仙子芳名？我叫胡哥，是灵药阁的一名负责人。”
陈长生随意应付，“江湖人都叫我黑寡妇。”
胡哥眼睛一亮，“寡妇好啊，寡妇妙，寡妇的活儿呱呱叫……”
陈长生差点喷出一口老血，回头狠狠瞪了他一眼，“找一个女管事来吧，我这人不喜欢和男人打交道。”
胡哥笑容一收，“呃……好吧！”
把陈长生引上二楼雅座，沏了茶，很快一名身材婀娜曼妙的少女缓缓走了进来。
这个女人看起来只有二八妙龄，穿鹅黄色宫装裙，眉如山黛，目如星辰，肤如凝脂，一颦一笑间勾魂夺魄。
论美貌不在顾清影之下，甚至有过之而无不及。
陈长生暗暗打量了一番她的修为不由心中一凛，这少女竟然是一名金丹期强者。
不愧是灵药阁，随随便便就出来一名金丹期强者。
在望仙宗，金丹期的通常都是长老级别。
她该不会看出来自己是个男的吧？
陈长生连忙站起来行了一礼，“见过前辈，小女子黑寡妇，想要出售一些低级丹药，不想却惊动前辈大驾。”

那鹅黄少女盈盈一笑，“仙子客气了，在我们灵药阁是没有那么多规矩的，别人都叫我飞鸿仙子，是这家灵药阁的掌柜，仙子坐下喝茶。”
那飞鸿仙子动作优雅，稍微一动便轻舞翩翩，如同仙子凌波，步步生花，眉宇间的风情似乎要溢出来一般。
让陈长生目光不由被深深吸引，不能自拔，似乎想要永远沉沦在她的温柔乡里。
好在这时，他丹田中的那个小鼎不由散发出来一丝凉意，让他连忙清醒过来，不敢再看。
不由惊出一身冷汗，这个女人好厉害，竟然天生魅惑。
果然是越漂亮的女人越是危险。
陈长生手一挥，手中顿时出现一个黄皮葫芦，里面的丹药主要有三种，聚气丹、辟谷丹和回元丹。
数量大概有五千多枚。
陈长生把葫芦推了过去，“前辈看看，这里的丹药价值几何？”
飞鸿仙子微微探出一丝神念进去，随即眉梢一挑，“这里的丹药都是刚祭炼没多久，仙子难道是一品炼丹师？”

"Collect the elixirs here!"
Chen Changsheng tidied his hair in embarrassment. He only had one grade of elixir in his hand, and he didn't know if the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion would accept it.
However, his action of combing his hair attracted many people. A person in charge hurriedly came over and said, "It turns out that the fairy is an alchemist. We collect elixirs here. Please follow me to the private room on the second floor."
After speaking, the person in charge subconsciously glanced at the deep groove on Chen Changsheng's chest and secretly swallowed hard.
"Be good, this ditch can pinch someone to death!"
Sensing the lewd gaze of the person in charge, Chen Changsheng couldn't help but shiver all over, and in his heart he greeted the eighteenth generation of Hongyun Patriarch's ancestors several times.
The man led the way and asked, "Dare you ask the fairy for her name? My name is Brother Hu, and I am the person in charge of the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion."
Chen Changsheng dealt with it casually, "People in the world call me Black Widow."
Brother Hu's eyes lit up, "The widow is good, the widow is wonderful, the widow's work is awesome..."
Chen Changsheng almost spat out a mouthful of old blood, turned around and glared at him fiercely, "Find a female manager, I don't like to deal with men."
Brother Hu's smile faded, "Uh... okay!"
He led Chen Changsheng to the seating area on the second floor, made tea, and soon a graceful girl walked in slowly.
This woman looks to be only in her mid-twenties. She is wearing a goose-yellow palace dress. She has eyebrows like mountain daisy, eyes like stars, and skin like gelatin. Her every frown and smile are captivating.
In terms of beauty, she is not inferior to Gu Qingying, or even worse.
Chen Changsheng secretly looked at her cultivation and couldn't help but feel shocked. This girl turned out to be a strong person at the Golden Core stage.
As expected of the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion, a strong man at the Golden Core Stage came out casually.
In Wangxian Sect, those at the Golden Core stage are usually at the elder level.
Wouldn't she be able to tell that she was a man?
Chen Changsheng quickly stood up and saluted, "I met my senior, the little girl Black Widow. She wanted to sell some low-level pills, but she didn't want to alarm my senior."
The goose-yellow girl smiled and said, "You're welcome, fairy. We don't have so many rules in our elixir pavilion. Others call me Fairy Feihong, and I am the shopkeeper of this elixir pavilion. Fairy, sit down and drink tea."
The Feihong Fairy's movements were graceful, and she danced gracefully at the slightest movement, like a fairy dancing on the waves, blooming with every step, and the charm between her brows seemed to overflow.
Chen Changsheng's eyes couldn't help but be deeply attracted, unable to extricate himself, as if he wanted to sink into her gentle hometown forever.
Fortunately, at this moment, the small cauldron in his dantian could not help but exude a coolness, which made him wake up quickly and did not dare to look again.
I couldn't help but break into a cold sweat. This woman was so powerful and so naturally charming.
Sure enough, the more beautiful a woman is, the more dangerous she is.
Chen Changsheng waved his hand, and a yellow-skinned gourd suddenly appeared in his hand. There were three main types of elixirs inside, namely Qi Gathering Pill, Bigu Pill and Huiyuan Pill.
The number is probably more than five thousand.
Chen Changsheng pushed the gourd over, "Senior, look, how much are the elixirs here worth?"
Fairy Feihong put out a trace of spiritual thought and then raised her eyebrows, "The elixirs here have just been sacrificed and refined not long ago. Is the fairy a first-class alchemist?"
